title: ci(test-ui): check-pending-changeset-literals "the tree as it stands satisfies the rule › exits 0 through the CLI" timed out (15 s) and turned the 4-hourly full run red on main
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a flake that turned `main` red (the 4-hourly full run, card #38065). Source: triage probe, R1447.

## 维护者速读

- 每 4 小时一次的全量测试在主干上红了一次。原因是一条测试要扫描整个代码树、调用一次命令行，在较慢的机器上超过了 15 秒上限。它不是代码错误。
- 按规矩，让主干变红的不稳定测试算 p1。修法是给这条整树测试留足时间，或者让它只扫描改动范围，不能删掉也不能跳过这条测试。

## Reading

- Run 46086203867 (`CI`, schedule, `main` at `27ee98438e`, 2026-11-28T00:07Z), job "Test UI (1/16)" (140796965590): `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts:172`, "3. the tree as it stands satisfies the rule › exits 0 through the CLI", `Error: Test timed out in 15000ms`. This is the only failure in the run.
- The case runs `ui/scripts/check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs` over the whole tree through the CLI, so its cost grows with the tree. On a slow full-run runner it crossed the 15 s case timeout. The last green 4-hourly run was 46060926437 (20:03Z).
- No existing card names this test (`is:issue check-pending-changeset-literals`).

## Fix

Give the whole-tree CLI case a timeout matched to its measured cost on the slowest shard, or make the check incremental (affected files only) with a separate bounded whole-tree pin. ⛔ Do not skip, narrow or delete the case: the remedy for the 4-hourly card is never to weaken the check.

## Done when

The case passes on the 4-hourly full run, and #38065 is closed by triage after a verified green run.
